test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Pipe R can empty a full tank in 30 hours. But two pipes P and Q can fill the tank in 15 hours and 10 hours, respectively. Ram unknowingly opened all three taps. After 2 hours Shyam realised it and closed Pipe R. Due to this mistake how much time more would it take to fill the tank?
solution:
**Given:**

Pipe R can empty a full tank in 30 hours.

Pipe P can fill the tank in 15 hours.

Pipe Q can fill the tank in 10 hours.

**Concept Used:**

Time Required = Capacity / Efficiency

**Calculation:**

Let the capacity of the tank be LCM of 30, 15 & 10.

Capacity of tank = 30 Units

Efficiency of Pipe R = 30/30 = -1 (∵ R empties the tank)

Efficiency of Pipe P = 30/15 = 2

Efficiency of Pipe Q = 30/10 = 3

According to the question, all 3 pipes were open for 2 hours:

⇒ (-1 + 2 + 3) × 2

⇒ 4 × 2

⇒ 8 Units

Now, remaining work = 30 - 8 = 22 Units

Time required to fill the remaining tank after closing Pipe R:

⇒ 22 / (3 + 2)

⇒ 22 / 5

⇒ 4.4 hours

Total time required due to this mistake:

⇒ 2 + 4.4 = 6.4 hours

If Pipe R was closed from the beginning, the work would be completed in:

⇒ 30 / 5 = 6 hours

More time taken:

⇒ 6.4 - 6

⇒ 0.4 hours

⇒ 0.4 × 60 = 24 minutes

**∴ More time it will take is 24 minutes.**
